Shenzhen TOPS Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Bao'an, Shenzhen. It has been recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise for 12 consecutive years and as a Shenzhen "Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative" SME for 6 consecutive years. With 21 years of focus on environmental and reliability test equipment, the company integrates R&D, manufacturing, sales, and full-scope service. It holds 27 product patents and 18 software copyrights, and possesses core proprietary technology, making it a manufacturer with strong technical barriers in the domestic high-end reliability test equipment field.
Its core products include high/low temperature humidity test chambers, rapid temperature change test chambers, thermal shock test chambers, high/low temperature low-pressure test chambers, and combined temperature/humidity/vibration test systems. It also customizes various non-standard climate environment simulation chambers and mechanical environment test equipment for drop, tensile, and insertion/extraction force testing, meeting the high-standard, differentiated, and customized reliability test requirements of many industries across the board.
After more than twenty years of accumulation, the company has consistently upheld the development philosophy of "technology leadership and quality first." It continues to refine precision temperature control algorithms, whole-chamber temperature field calibration, adaptation to extreme operating conditions, safety protection systems, and localized service systems. Overall product performance, operational stability, test accuracy, and full-lifecycle service capability have broken through the performance limits of traditional equipment in the industry. Machine reliability, test accuracy, and safety protection standards are benchmarked against leading international imported brands such as Weiss (Germany), ESPEC (Japan), and Hitachi, fully meeting the strict test and certification specifications of high-end manufacturing. The company can deliver high-quality domestic substitution for imported high-end test equipment brands and mainstream Taiwanese brands, and serves high-end fields including automotive electronics, new energy lithium batteries, semiconductor components, 5G communications, AI servers, optoelectronic displays, medical electronics, consumer electronics, and aerospace and defense. It is a leading reliability test company in several precision manufacturing niche segments.
The company's products include: high/low temperature (humidity) test chambers, rapid temperature change test chambers, thermal shock test chambers, high/low temperature low-pressure test chambers, temperature-humidity-vibration combined test chambers, and other non-standard custom climate environment simulation chambers; drop, tensile, insertion/extraction force, and other non-standard custom mechanical environment simulation testers.

深圳市鼎准电子有限公司创立于2005年，扎根深圳宝安，是连续12年国家级高新技术企业、连续6年深圳市专精特新中小企业。公司深耕环境与可靠性试验设备领域21年，集研发、生产、销售、全域服务于一体，手握27项产品专利及18项软件著作权，掌握核心自主研发技术，是国内高端可靠性测试设备领域极具技术壁垒的智造企业。
公司核心产品涵盖高低温湿热试验箱、快速温变试验箱、冷热冲击试验箱、高低温低气压试验箱、温湿振复合试验设备，同时可定制各类非标气候环境模拟试验室及跌落、拉力、插拔力等机械环境测试设备，能够全方位满足各行业高标准、差异化、定制化的可靠性试验验证需求。
二十余年深耕积淀，公司始终秉持“技术领先、品质至上”的发展理念，持续深耕精密控温算法、全域温场校准、极限工况适配、安全防护体系及本土化服务体系的迭代优化，产品综合性能、运行稳定性、测试精度及全周期服务能力，已全面突破行业传统设备性能边界。整机可靠性、测试精准度与安全防护标准，对标德国韦思、日本爱斯佩克、日立等国际一线进口品牌，完全适配高端制造严苛的试验与认证规范，可全方位实现高端试验设备进口品牌、传统台系主流品牌的优质国产化替代，广泛赋能汽车电子、新能源锂电、半导体元器件、5G通讯、AI服务器、光电显示、医疗电子、消费电子、航空军工等高端领域，是多精密制造细分赛道的可靠性测试引领企业。
公司产品包括：高低温（湿热）试验箱，快速温变试验箱，冷热冲击试验箱，高低温低气压试验箱，温湿度结合振动试验箱及其它非标定制气候环境模拟试验箱; 跌落/拉力/插拔力及其它非标定制机械环境模拟试验机。

高低温交变湿热试验箱
고온 및 저온 또는 교대되는 습도 및 열 환경에서 샘플의 전기적 및 물리적 특성의 적합성을 테스트하고 확인하는 데 사용됩니다. 항공 우주, 전기 및 전자, 가전 제품, 통신, 자동차, 신 에너지, 군사 및 기타 산업에 적합합니다. 고온 보관, 저온 보관, 고온 및 습도, 교대 습도 및 기타 기후 환경 테스트를 수행할 수 있습니다.
用于检验及验证样品在高低温或湿热交变环境下，其电性能，物理性能的符合性；适用于航空航天、电工电子，家用电器，通讯通信，汽车，新能源，军工等行业；可执行高温贮储，低温贮储，高温高湿，湿热交变等多项气候环境测试。

This equipment measures the insertion and extraction force of various connectors. Combined with a patented automatic alignment device, it yields fully accurate insertion/extraction force values. The in-house developed patented test software, which runs on Windows, lets all parameters and test conditions be set through input. Test data, force-displacement curves, life curves, and inspection reports are all generated automatically after testing. In addition to standard insertion/extraction tests, the machine can perform push-pull tests with set time, force, and displacement. With a contact resistance measurement module, contact resistance can be recorded and measured to accurately determine the actual service life.
设备适用于各种连接器插入、拔出的力度测试，搭配专利设计的自动对准装置，可得到完全准确的插拔力;基于 Windows 操作系统的自行开发的专利测试软件可实现所有参数与试验条件输入式设定; 诸如测试数据，荷重&位移曲线图，寿命曲线图，检查报表测试完后均自动生成；该机除可进行常规插拔试验外，还可执行定时定力定位移的拉压测试，配置接触电阻测量模块可对接触电阻进行记录测量以便准确判定其实际寿命。
